note: Reference output of `scripts/reproduce.sh` for this implementation on this setup. Split sizes and cell counts are deterministic and are checked exactly. Timings depend on the machine and on --jobs, so t*/oracle is reported for comparison but only loosely bounded.

tolerance.comment: Ratios cancel machine speed but not solver nondeterminism or CPU contention, so they are bounded at 25%. Sample and cell counts must match exactly — they come from the cell library and the presets, not from timing.
